About

I am Adeyinka Giwa, a full stack software engineer focused on building reliable products that solve practical business problems. I work across frontend and backend systems and ship features from initial design through deployment.

My recent work includes products built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Laravel, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and Docker, with deployments on Vercel and AWS EC2. I have also integrated payments with Stripe, implemented authentication flows, and worked with REST APIs and background jobs.

I am actively expanding into machine learning engineering. I have spent focused time learning FastAPI for model serving patterns, practiced core ML foundations by implementing gradient descent for linear regression from scratch, and gained hands on experience integrating AI agents into product workflows.
